name: ugt-core
description: Stack-agnostic org foundation shared by every UGT stack platform: the ugt-checkpoint team-state skill, the ugt-mode model-routing skill, the audit-trail hooks, and the normative contracts (database naming, delivery pipeline, identity/RBAC, harness mechanism) that stack platforms render in their own terms. Installed automatically as a dependency of ugt-<stack>-platform plugins — never installed directly.
